lyricsStudio.description: Split-editor songwriting workspace with generation, multilingual support, rhyme tools, tone analysis, and auto-save.
promptTemplates: Write a heartfelt song about long-distance love with vivid imagery.
Create a high-energy anthem for late-night city drives.
Craft a reflective song about resilience after failure.
Build a celebratory chorus for a summer festival hit.
emptyAutocompleteSuggestions: A cinematic anthem about rising above fear
A soulful love song with bilingual lyrics
An energetic club record with crowd chants
rewriteDefaults: Write an emotionally rich radio-ready pop record with vivid imagery.
Create a bilingual anthem with a clear hook and call-and-response chorus.

promptEnhancer.empty: Write a {mood} {genre} song with a memorable hook and clear verse-to-chorus progression.
promptEnhancer.append: {prompt} Write it as a {genre} track with a {mood} tone, include a standout hook, and keep the lines singable.

rewriteAppend.vivid: Focus on vivid sensory details and concise lines.
rewriteAppend.emotional: Add a stronger emotional arc from verse to chorus.
rewriteAppend.rhyme: Keep rhyme endings tighter for better memorability.
